nodes.rationale: Stair/escalator 1.85x rise, ramp 12x rise, elevator 15 m wait + rise; gives longest route and access route to any room; per-level scores unchanged

nodes.norm_label: web app (index.html + engine.js + app.js, no server/build)

nodes.label: Edge/Chrome app-mode launch with own profile and bridge page
nodes.norm_label: edge/chrome app-mode launch with own profile and bridge page
nodes.rationale: Own profile so window size is respected when Edge is already open; bridge page keeps the # fragment that a double click would lose

nodes.label: Exportar pushbutton (export.xaml + export_window.py)
nodes.rationale: Narrow vertical window in the app's Aura style; read-only (no transactions), cancelable, links selectable

nodes.label: Model requirements (rooms, floors, SA_ params, Type Mark, vertical circulation)
nodes.norm_label: model requirements (rooms, floors, sa_ params, type mark, vertical circulation)

nodes.label: Paneles laterales: un solo lenguaje
nodes.rationale: Tablero and inspector are built from the same pieces in app/index.html; anything new gets a new piece here before hand styling

nodes.label: space-model.json contract v1
nodes.rationale: The only junction between Revit and the app: if it changes both sides change and schema is bumped

nodes.label: HSBC Space Analytics (project)
nodes.rationale: Client data: repo is private and exports are never stored in it

nodes.label: Estado .pst (icon + text, never color alone)
nodes.rationale: Status must not rely on color alone (Cumple / Mejorar / Atención)

nodes.label: Panel rules (text scale, color, no repeats, same names)
nodes.norm_label: panel rules (text scale, color, no repeats, same names)
nodes.rationale: Text scale 10/11/12.5/17/20/38 px only; pillar color only on its icon/bar/mark, violet for active; each control lives in one panel only

nodes.label: Contract general rules (meters, internal coords, absolute Z, ids as text)
nodes.norm_label: contract general rules (meters, internal coords, absolute z, ids as text)
nodes.rationale: Absolute Z lets the app decide what each level cuts, so double-height elements appear on both levels; text ids fit Revit 2024+ 64-bit ids

nodes.label: One model per document, no design stages
nodes.norm_label: one model per document, no design stages
nodes.rationale: App analyzes one model at a time; legacy source.stage is ignored and multi-model exports use the last one with a warning

nodes.label: IronPython 2.7 engine (no #! python3)
nodes.rationale: #! python3 would move a script to CPython where pyrevit.forms does not work; a test guards it

nodes.label: Python 2.7/3 compatibility rules (ElementId.Value)
nodes.rationale: No f-strings/annotations/nonlocal/bare super(); IntegerValue does not exist in 2026+, sa_revit.common.id_value uses it only as fallback

nodes.label: Restart Revit after changing lib/
nodes.rationale: pyRevit keeps imported modules for the session; Reload only rereads button scripts and ribbon

nodes.label: UI lives in buttons, never in lib/sa_revit
nodes.norm_label: ui lives in buttons, never in lib/sa_revit
nodes.rationale: Layering: sa_model imports no Revit/pyRevit/clr/System; sa_revit imports no pyrevit; tests guard it and validate XAML names/events

nodes.label: Command palette (Ctrl K, search quality or action)
nodes.norm_label: command palette (ctrl k, search quality or action)

nodes.label: Model families modal (GWP, cost, recycled; CSV export, isolate/select)
nodes.norm_label: model families modal (gwp, cost, recycled; csv export, isolate/select)

nodes.label: Inspector panel (focused pillar card, suggested actions)
nodes.norm_label: inspector panel (focused pillar card, suggested actions)

nodes.label: space-model.json drop zone and file inputs
nodes.norm_label: space-model.json drop zone and file inputs

nodes.label: Pillars board panel (pboard, relations, layers)
nodes.rationale: Score against goal per pillar; clicking a pillar or relation paints it on the plan. Replaced the earlier Senses instrument as the default left panel.

nodes.label: Plan layers control (icon row + opacity sliders)
nodes.norm_label: plan layers control (icon row + opacity sliders)

nodes.label: Presentation mode (cover, indicators board, per-room heatmap, method)
nodes.norm_label: presentation mode (cover, indicators board, per-room heatmap, method)
nodes.rationale: Editorial, lots of air, big numbers; status always shown with icon plus text (colorblind-validated).

nodes.label: Room card popover (zpop, Ficha del room)
nodes.norm_label: room card popover (zpop, ficha del room)

nodes.label: Embedded space-model-data JSON script slot
nodes.rationale: Placeholder (null) allows a model to be inlined into the page at export time instead of loaded by drag-and-drop.

nodes.label: Compact summary panel (dgw, #resumen=1)
nodes.rationale: Same side panel shown alone and full height, used as a narrow summary view (e.g. Revit dockable).

nodes.label: Top bar (Abrir, Buscar, Familias, Re-analizar, Presentar, theme, sound)
nodes.norm_label: top bar (abrir, buscar, familias, re-analizar, presentar, theme, sound)

nodes.label: Test fixture app/index.html for portable HTML inlining
nodes.norm_label: test fixture app/index.html for portable html inlining
nodes.rationale: Exercises inliner edge cases: CDN script (must stay external), nested js/geometry.js, module script with ./app.js, and missing.js that does not exist.

nodes.label: Analysis grid cell size (0.5 m / 1.0 m)
nodes.norm_label: analysis grid cell size (0.5 m / 1.0 m)

nodes.label: Client priorities (pillar weights, weighted index)
nodes.rationale: Weight expresses how much each pillar matters to the client and only moves the weighted index; it never changes the plan or scores. Without agreed weights the index is indicative.

nodes.label: Excel table join by Type Mark (GWP, Reciclado, VOC, NRC, EPD, Costo)
nodes.norm_label: excel table join by type mark (gwp, reciclado, voc, nrc, epd, costo)

nodes.label: How to read the instrument (anatomy legend)
nodes.norm_label: how to read the instrument (anatomy legend)
nodes.rationale: Filled arc = pillar score 0-100 on model grid; arc length = client weight; tick = goal; rings = Persona/Operación/Planeta scale; center = weighted index and tension; threads = pillar relations; click only focuses, never deletes.

nodes.label: Side panel design language (.phd/.pbody/.sec/.row/.b4/.rc/.ib)
nodes.rationale: Left board and right inspector share one language: fixed header, scrolling flat sections, focused item in a card, a single 4px bar with goal tick, fixed text scale; accent violet, never black.

nodes.label: Status semaphore (ok/mid/low icon + text, colorblind safe)
nodes.norm_label: status semaphore (ok/mid/low icon + text, colorblind safe)

nodes.label: Rainbow Conic-Gradient Ring Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: All pyRevit button icons reuse the app's rainbow conic-gradient ring (purple-pink-orange-green-blue) with a center glyph, so the Revit ribbon carries the same brand mark as the web app; dark variants use a light grey glyph for contrast on dark Revit themes.

nodes.label: Light/Dark Icon Theme Variants (pyRevit)
nodes.rationale: pyRevit picks icon.dark.png when Revit uses a dark UI theme; the glyph switches from near-black (light theme) to light grey (dark theme) while the ring stays identical.

nodes.label: Space Analytics brand mark (rainbow gradient ring)
nodes.norm_label: space analytics brand mark (rainbow gradient ring)
nodes.rationale: All ribbon icons share a circular multicolor (orange-pink-purple-blue-green) gradient ring with a white center, giving the pyRevit buttons the app's brand identity; the center glyph distinguishes each command and is dark grey in light variants and light grey in dark-theme variants.

nodes.label: graphify update . after code changes
nodes.rationale: AST-only, no API cost; graph.json is rewritten whole each build so large diffs are expected

nodes.label: Query graph before grep/read rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output
